New 
One-click invoicing to QuickBooks Online
› 



Stop re-typing invoices. Send client invoices straight from your schedule into
QuickBooks Online in one click. Every shift worked becomes an invoice line automatically, with
customers, service items, invoice numbers, terms and sales tax handled for you. Work that used to
take days of manual transfer each month now takes minutes.


See It in a Live Demo 













The Operating System for Modern Security Guard Companies


Automate scheduling. Enforce license compliance. Prevent costly mistakes. Streamline guard
communication. Generate invoices instantly.



Book a Live Demo 
Watch 3-Minute Overview 



Built by senior IT professionals and designed with decades of military and private security
experience.















Where Security Companies Lose Money

Security operations are complex. Mistakes are expensive.


- Expired guard cards slipping through

- Double-booked officers

- Overtime errors

- No-shows and last-minute chaos

- Manual compliance tracking

- Delayed invoicing

- Paper-based incident reports

- Disconnected scheduling and billing systems



Every one of these issues costs time, money, and reputation. SecurityAssignments eliminates
operational risk at the source.









The Solution



1. Mistake-Proof Scheduling


Five automated assignment methods. Smart conflict detection. Overtime controls. Instant
guard confirmations.


No more spreadsheet chaos.



2. Automated License & Qualification Enforcement


Assignments are validated against guard credentials before deployment. If a
qualification doesn’t match — it doesn’t schedule.


Compliance built in.



3. Multi-Channel Guard Notifications

Notify officers instantly via SMS, email, and mobile app.

Track confirmations in real time.



4. Onsite Check-In & Reporting

Geofenced clock-in and clock-out. Real-time incident reporting. Full audit trail.

Protect your company with documented proof.



5. Automated Invoicing & Reporting


Generate invoices automatically based on completed assignments. Export detailed reports
instantly.


New: one-click invoice posting to QuickBooks Online.
